The '''Caulus Tertius system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caulus Tertius]].
